name: Mortal Wounds procs from triggered direct harmful critical strikes on the tank training dummy (#13062)
contract: Mortal Wounds 504292 ('Your direct harmful critical strikes with spells and abilities now cause the target to bleed')
had AttributesMask 0 in spell_proc (rev_20260920_50_bloodmage_crit_procs.sql) and lacks SPELL_ATTR3_CAN_PROC_FROM_PROCS.
Aura::GetProcEffectMask therefore rejected every triggered direct harmful spell that lacks SPELL_ATTR3_NOT_A_PROC,
including Blood Shard 504115, Hematoma 803392 (triggered every 1000 ms by Final Embrace 524865), Clotting 806214 and
Purify Blood 573273. Setting AttributesMask 2 (PROC_ATTR_TRIGGERED_CAN_PROC) allows triggered direct harmful crits
to apply Mortal Wounds 504291 while keeping ProcFlags 69904 (direct spells/abilities, excluding white swings and DoTs).
This scenario uses a level-60 Bloodmage against Dynamic Tank Training Dummy 967182 with Crit Test Buff 503747 (+100%
crit chance). Bloodbolt 578305 engages the neutral dummy before 504292 is learned, Final Embrace 524865 triggers
Hematoma 803392 (AttributesEx3 = 0, no SPELL_ATTR3_NOT_A_PROC) with no 504291 bleed before learning 504292, and once
504292 is learned while Final Embrace is still ticking, the next triggered Hematoma crit must apply 504291.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Keep the tank dummy's swings well above 1 HP so MaintainSession never resets the dummy
Crit Test Buff 503747 (+100% crit chance) forces every strike to crit
Engage the neutral Dynamic Tank Training Dummy before learning Mortal Wounds
Allow Bloodbolt hit and 1500 ms GCD to clear before Final Embrace
Cast Final Embrace to trigger Hematoma 803392 every 1000 ms
CONTROL: triggered Hematoma 803392 hits the engaged tank dummy
CONTROL: without Mortal Wounds, triggered Hematoma crits apply no bleed
Learn Mortal Wounds while Final Embrace continues triggering Hematoma
DISCRIMINATING: triggered Hematoma 803392 critical strike applies Mortal Wounds 504291
